held_out_evaluation.command: studies/campaign/runs/training-2026-11-22/evaluations/evaluate.sh: studies.campaign.run evaluate --target all --seeds 1009,1013,1019,1021,1031,1033 --baseline-style balanced --simulations 64 --max-depth 16 --max-transitions 10000 --neural-device cpu, from the run's code folder, one CPU core; the control adds --target-script balanced

japan_in_china.method: watch_japan.py replays the six Axis games of each player of evaluate.sh with evaluate(track_japan=True) and logs Japan's actions; the replays reproduced every game's final scores. self_play_japan.py replays, without searching, the 16 self-play games in play at 19:10 (move logs copied to self-play-moves/). China's 13 land zones are those named land_china_.

wealth_at_game_end_in_the_axis_games.source: each game's wealth_components_at_stop in the evaluation reports, means over the six Axis games

wealth_at_start.source: CampaignAdapter.wealth() at the start of a game, the same for every seed
